## Summary

Describe the skill or documentation change and why it is needed.

## Scope

- [ ] Skill instructions
- [ ] Skill examples
- [ ] Skill scripts
- [ ] Shared resources
- [ ] Documentation only

## Verification

Commands run:

```sh
find skills resources -type f | sort
```

## Checklist

- [ ] Public docs match current skill behavior.
- [ ] Examples are safe to publish and contain no private project data.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, screenshots with private data, local paths, or temporary audits are included.
